# Release Readiness Checklist: Claude/Codex Cutover and Universal Install Release Gate

**Purpose**: Validate that XPLAT-008 release-readiness requirements define payload completeness, installed-plugin proof, UAT fill state, public-claim safety, and final publication blockers clearly enough for implementation.
**Created**: 2026-07-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist release-readiness` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Aggregate Release Gate Blockers

- [x] CHK001 Are all final publication blocker classes named for active shell runtime dependencies, incomplete payloads, missing bundled agents, missing hooks, missing runner files, stale metadata, missing trust metadata, unsafe public claims, incomplete UAT evidence, unsafe repair claims, missing traceability, and nondeterministic dist output? [Completeness, Spec FR-008/FR-019, SC-005, Release Readiness Contract]
- [x] CHK002 Is release readiness defined as an aggregate blocking contract with explicit pass/fail status and blocking count rather than a collection of advisory checks? [Measurability, Research Decision 6, Data Model ReleaseReadinessGateRecord, Release Readiness Contract]
- [x] CHK003 Are seeded negative cases required for every major release blocker class so the gate proves it fails before public release when proof is incomplete? [Measurability, Spec SC-005, Plan Slice 2, Release Readiness Contract]
- [x] CHK004 Are release gate evidence fields required for payload results, UAT matrix, install health, public claims, runner invocations, and requirement traceability? [Traceability, Spec FR-020, Data Model ReleaseReadinessGateRecord, Release Readiness Contract]
- [x] CHK005 Is release readiness required to detect source-checkout pass but installed-plugin proof failure rather than accepting source-only gate success? [Coverage, Workflow Release-Readiness Prompt, Spec US1/US4, Plan Target Platform]

## Payload, Metadata, And Dist Proof

- [x] CHK006 Are Claude and Codex generated payloads required to be rebuilt from source before release-readiness proof is accepted? [Completeness, Spec FR-006, Research Decision 5, Plan Slice 2]
- [x] CHK007 Are generated payload gates required to verify expected release metadata, bundled agents, hooks, runner files, runner manifest/checksum metadata, and XPLAT-003 trust records for both payload families? [Completeness, Spec FR-007, SC-003, Payload Completeness Contract]
- [x] CHK008 Are stale, missing, extra, changed, path-leaking, or nondeterministic generated files defined as release blockers rather than warnings? [Measurability, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Research Decision 6, Data Model PayloadCompletenessResult]
- [x] CHK009 Is version synchronization blocking across source manifests, generated manifests, marketplace indexes, `.release-please-manifest.json`, runner manifest `plugin_version`, and generated release evidence while keeping manual plugin version edits out of scope? [Consistency, Spec FR-021, Research Decision 6, Constitution Principle III]
- [x] CHK010 Are required source-to-dist transforms, including Claude guard stripping, Codex overlays or path rewrites, and manifest path normalization, included in release-readiness comparison requirements? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Plan Technical Decisions, Payload Completeness Contract]

## Native UAT And Installed-Plugin Evidence

- [x] CHK011 Are exactly six Claude/Codex by Windows/macOS/Linux UAT rows required before native platform support can be claimed? [Completeness, Spec FR-012, SC-004, Research Decision 7, UAT Matrix Contract]
- [x] CHK012 Is every UAT row required to include install, bundled-agent verification, first use, scaffold/status, autopilot dry-run, latest-tag update, and incomplete-install repair evidence? [Completeness, Spec FR-013, Plan Slice 3, Data Model NativeUATRow]
- [x] CHK013 Are UAT rows required to be reviewer-readable with operator/date, host version, plugin version or latest tag, installed cache path, interpreter resolution, expected result, actual result, evidence link, notes, and pass/fail status? [Measurability, Spec Clarifications Session 3, Research Decision 7, UAT Matrix Contract]
- [x] CHK014 Does release readiness block missing rows, placeholder-only rows, smoke-only evidence, failing rows, empty expected or actual results, raw HTML anchors, missing evidence links, and public support claims not backed by passing rows? [Measurability, Spec FR-014, Spec Edge Cases, Data Model NativeUATRow]
- [x] CHK015 Is latest-tag update proof tied to installed Claude and Codex payloads rerunning first-use journeys successfully after update? [Coverage, Spec FR-018, Plan Slice 3, UAT Matrix Contract]

## Public Claims, Repair, And Review Packet

- [x] CHK016 Are docs, README guidance, and release notes required to match implemented controls and completed UAT rows, including rejecting unsupported native-platform and cryptographic guarantees? [Consistency, Spec FR-011, SC-007, Research Decision 9]
- [x] CHK017 Are installed-plugin prerequisites in public install and first-run guidance constrained to the supported Python runner path and prohibited from requiring Bash, Git Bash, WSL, PowerShell-specific command language, shell interpolation, shell redirection, Unix-only paths, or `jq`? [Coverage, Spec FR-003/FR-009/FR-010, Plan Constraints]
- [x] CHK018 Is safe repair evidence limited to trusted missing or stale installed-cache artifacts with verified expected path, source identity, release channel or latest tag, and SHA-256 or file-tree digest? [Clarity, Spec FR-016, Research Decision 8, Install Health Repair Contract]
- [x] CHK019 Does release readiness reject unsafe repair claims, broad reinstall behavior, wipe-copy behavior, unknown drift, trust-root changes, out-of-cache paths, and unverified mismatches in favor of exact manual remediation? [Measurability, Spec FR-017, SC-006, Data Model RepairAction]
- [x] CHK020 Is the PR review packet required to order active source/runtime changes before generated payloads, docs, UAT evidence, and release-readiness output while tracing major requirements and success criteria to changed files and verification evidence? [Traceability, Spec FR-020, SC-008, Plan PR Review Packet Source]
